description: Get curated data-center industry news. Filter by keyword, category, source and date range.

category.description: News topic filter, e.g. deals, permits, outages, policy, AI

limit.description: Max results to return (1-500; default varies by tool)

min_relevance.description: Minimum relevance score 0-1 to include an item, e.g. 0.5

query.description: Free-text keyword to filter news, e.g. "Stargate" or "interconnection queue"

source.description: Restrict to one trade source, e.g. DCD, "Data Center Frontier", "Capacity Media"

name: get_news
title: Industry News
